plugins.name: whydiff
plugins.description: Follow the meaning of a change — its architectural and logical decisions — without reading every file an LLM touched. /whydiff turns a git diff into an interactive review map: causal story, cause-grouped changes, diff-marked flow and schema diagrams, standards, tests and ops reports, blast radius — all with drill-down to the code.
